name: Yusuf Solis
life: “I still remember being given a villain's line because I read it without fear.” People around the entrance to the Wash House know Yusuf by a small Wednesday habit. Yusuf stops for local notices even on a day without a load to wash.
voice: I play the villain. My dad has never seen me do anything at school except get in trouble.
appearance: Yusuf has a small notch in the left eyebrow. Look for a long plait tucked inside the collar. Outside school, the familiar outfit is a charcoal zip cardigan with a pen clipped inside the neckline. In conversation Yusuf listens with the head tilted a little to the left.
personality: Yusuf uses precise names for tools and very approximate names for feelings. People who know Yusuf well listen to what gets repaired after a difficult conversation.
agenda: To let the father see the child in a lead scene.
family: Hollis Parker is Yusuf’s older cousin. The household has two versions of an old recipe because somebody detested onions and never admitted it to the original cook. A person sitting down to eat gets to choose. Yusuf likes to give the old cook the first taste. Asked about *The spare spectacles*, Hollis says, “I signed something blurry once. I brought my own glasses and stayed until she read every word.”
connections: Kai Bruno. The student villain and the stage manager both have memories riding on a parent getting into the room.

reactions.response: Yusuf checks who can actually stay and which ride home would be lost.
